## Purpose
Pieces shared by the remote-server workflow panels.

## Responsibilities
- `RemoteWorkflowSelect`: workflows unpacked on an SSH server, with how many containers are up (`remoteWorkflows`).
- `CommandRunOutput`: follows a command's deployment log (`deployment`), with cancel (`cancelCommand`).
- `KeyValueRow` and `KeyValueRows`.

## Key elements
The exports listed.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Used by the console, the build, deploy and run panels.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **`CommandRunOutput` uses the same query key that `DeploymentLog` polls,** so it reads the status already fetched; it re-reads after a cancel because the run may already have ended.

## How to rebuild this file
Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
